notes: power_game: authoritative power from game table at upgrade_level=0 (lv1 in-game)
army_scale: power_game / hero_only_stats_at_lv0; =1.0 for army_type=0, <1.0 for specific armies
total_power at each upgrade/promote level = army_scale × sum(hero_stat × coeff)
Only stat IDs {50005, 50008, 50010} (HP, ATK, DEF) contribute to displayed power
Combat stats (75953, 76053, 76057, etc.) are battle-only, excluded from hero power
upgrade_levels: level_index is 1-based (idx=1 = lv0 in-game), upgrade_level = idx-1
promote_tiers: stat grants when item reaches that promote tier
